info.title: AirshedOS API
info.description: Phase 2A. Environmental providers and independent citizen interpretation. No evidence fusion or causal attribution. Demo incident sharing is simulated.

get.description: Configuration presence only; no network call or credential disclosure.
Independent environmental context; never corroborates the fictional demo incident.

parameters.name: at

schema.description: Optional reference time. Ground providers still query current conditions. Satellite uses this as its window end. Include a timezone.
schema.title: At

parameters.description: Optional reference time. Ground providers still query current conditions. Satellite uses this as its window end. Include a timezone.

get.description: Independent bounded satellite lookup; lets the UI show ground data without waiting.

schema.title: Response List Incidents Api V1 Incidents Get

image.title: Image
image.description: One JPEG/PNG, maximum 5 MiB and 16 MP

temporal_note.title: Temporal Note
temporal_note.default: AQ, weather and FIRMS query current conditions. Satellite uses its explicit search window.

insufficient_evidence.title: Insufficient Evidence
insufficient_evidence.description: True only when visual ambiguity prevents choosing an event category. False for a clear no_visible_pollution scene. True requires uncertain with low confidence.

safety_note.const: AI interpretation — requires environmental corroboration. Visual evidence only; an image cannot establish pollutant concentration, source causality or a violation.
safety_note.title: Safety Note
safety_note.default: AI interpretation — requires environmental corroboration. Visual evidence only; an image cannot establish pollutant concentration, source causality or a violation.

temporal_note.title: Temporal Note
temporal_note.default: Latest usable observation per product; acquisition times may differ. Not real-time.

measurement_note.title: Measurement Note
measurement_note.default: Satellite atmospheric columns are regional context and are not equivalent to ground-level pollutant concentrations.

note.title: Note
note.default: L3 ingestion QA is upstream; original per-pixel QA is not exposed. Not a confidence score.
